_comment: Patch these blocks into the mediczy-app ECS task definition to use LiveKit Cloud while keeping LiveKit Cloud token server OFF.
_instructions: Store LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET in SSM Parameter Store as SecureString values.
LIVEKIT_URL is the WebSocket URL returned to browsers and mobile clients.
LIVEKIT_API_URL is the HTTPS host used by server-side RoomServiceClient diagnostics/status calls.
Merge environmentPatch entries into the mediczy-app container environment array.
Merge secretsPatch entries into the mediczy-app container secrets array.
Register a new mediczy-app task definition revision and update the ECS service.
